0.literal: I am Youda, the manager of this establishment.
0.official: My name is Youda, and I'm the manager here.

2.literal: Nah. Wait a little longer for me.
2.official: Sorry, no. Can you gimme just a minute?

3.literal: The goal is to make it the number one club in the area.
3.official: Your final goal: to establish Sunshine as the undisputed top club in Sotenbori!

4.literal: By talking to Youda inside the club,
4.official: by talking to Youda inside Sunshine.

5.literal: Showdowns with rival clubs and drama will unfold one after another.
5.official: As Sunshine's popularity increases and the clash with your rivals' clubs heats up, the drama will unfold.

6.literal: you'll become able to learn new techniques you can use in battle,
6.official: you'll unlock new combat techniques Majima can learn to become even stronger

7.literal: and you'll be able to earn money efficiently.
7.official: By driving Sunshine's popularity up, you can transform it into a source of tremendous profit

8.literal: Aim to become the strongest manager, and a billionaire!
8.official: Grow the club, smash the competition, and become the true Cabaret Club Czar (and get filthy rich in the process)!

9.literal: ...So, well, I guess that's about it for the overview.
9.official: ...I'd say that about covers the basics, anyway.

10.literal: I'll be there to back you up on the details!
10.official: I'll chime in with advice as we go.

11.literal: Those guys are Sagawa's underlings too...

12.literal: I wanna get a massage quick,
12.official: I'm ready for a nice massage

13.literal: and have someone loosen up this stiff, creaky body of mine!
13.official: to beat my busted-up body back into some kinda shape!

14.literal: Meanwhile, I gotta find the hidden door...!
14.official: (Hopefully that'll keep 'em thinkin' I'm still inside a while. Long enough to find this door and get gone, anyway.)

15.literal: No need to hesitate. For this very day,

16.literal: haven't I been enduring it all this time?
16.official: I been playin' lap dog this whole time for a chance like this.

17.literal: I don't wanna feel as miserable as I did back then ever again.
17.official: (I ain't goin' through that humiliation again.)

19.literal: You and me both will get wiped out by my employer.
19.official: Soon as the guy who hired me to do it finds out I'm keepin' you alive, he's gonna kill us both.

20.literal: It's what they call 'lying is sometimes a means to an end'!
20.official: Sometimes ya gotta tell a white lie!

21.literal: I'm... blind too, though only in one eye.
21.official: I'm... It's just one eye, but I was blinded, too.

22.literal: I was locked up for a long time too...
22.official: And I got locked up, for a long time, in a place where any day coulda been my last.

23.literal: Though compared to you, it was probably like paradise.
23.official: Was probably heaven compared to what you went through.

24.literal: I still had one eye left. I'm a lot better off than you.
24.official: I still got one good eye, too. Next to you, I'm a lucky guy.

25.literal: Saying stuff like this ain't much comfort, huh.
25.official: Sorry, not doin' a very good job at cheerin' you up here.

26.literal: If anything, I just said somethin' I shouldn't have.
26.official: Ahh... Look, sorry. I went and made ya feel worse.

27.literal: ...Oh, I know! Ain't you hungry? Huh?
27.official: Ooh, I know! You hungry? Eh?

30.literal: People can't muster any strength without putting something in their stomachs.

31.literal: ...Hang on. I'll get you fed right now.
31.official: Gimme half a shake, I'll have a plate ready for ya.

32.literal: It was kind of an accident, and it got completely crushed.
32.official: Almost more of an accident. Totally destroyed.

33.literal: They said my eyes are psychogenic, so they might heal someday.
33.official: But mine is caused by emotional trauma, so there's a chance I'll recover.

34.literal: At most, it just ruined my good looks.
34.official: My only complaint's that it ruined such a handsome face.

35.literal: When I had both eyes, anyway.
35.official: I was with a matchin' pair of eyes, anyway.

36.literal: You can't even see it. You're a weird one.
36.official: Ain't that a little odd for a blind girl?

37.literal: But you know, this plays a music box tune.
37.official: But this one plays a little music box chime.

38.literal: It's so cute, and it soothes me.
38.official: It sounds so cute, it always makes me smile.

39.literal: But it's a token of the time when I was still well.
39.official: But it's a memento of back when my life was still normal.

40.literal: Because I keep fixating on things like that,
40.official: It's because I keep clinging on to stuff like this

41.literal: no matter how much time passes, I never see reality.
41.official: that I still can't face reality.

42.literal: Just hang in there a little longer till then.
42.official: Just sit tight till then, yeah?

43.literal: ...Does the name Sagawa ring a bell?
43.official: You ever heard the name Sagawa before?

44.literal: Are you... being threatened by this Sagawa person?
44.official: So is this Sagawa person blackmailing you into this?

45.literal: But I was set to get a reward for killing you.
45.official: But I ain't innocent here. Killing you was the price of him doin' me a favor.

46.literal: I was employed by a mainland Chinese organization.
46.official: Did contract work for a mainland organization.

47.literal: You think she was just lying by the roadside?
47.official: You think she was just lyin' on the side of the road?

48.literal: ...did. They'd been in a mess fighting over the racket in women.
48.official: Turf war over the slave trade.

49.literal: There were two guys in the warehouse. When I took care of 'em,
49.official: There was two of 'em in that storehouse. After killin' them,

50.literal: there were a whole bunch of half-naked women locked up in there...
50.official: I'm left with a room fulla half-naked girls in cages.

51.literal: The moment I unlocked it, they all scrambled to escape first.
51.official: Soon as I unlocked the doors, they all bolted...

52.literal: There was just one girl who couldn't move.
52.official: All except one. One of 'em couldn't move an inch.

53.literal: She gripped it tight and wouldn't let go.
53.official: Once she found it, she latched on and wouldn't let go.

54.literal: Crying and repeating 'thank you' over and over...
54.official: Just knelt there cryin' and saying "thank you" over and over.

55.literal: So you've... been like a parent to her ever since.
55.official: So you've been playin' big daddy to her ever since.

56.literal: She was sickly ever since she was little. From the side effects of her medicine,
56.official: She was always real sick, even as a baby. The side effects of the drugs she needed were rough...

57.literal: That gesture... with the Makoto from back then,

58.official: It was just like the one I remembered.

59.literal: I'll kill as many total strangers as it takes.
59.official: If it's to protect my girl, I'll kill any stranger you put in front of me.

60.literal: You're underestimating the yakuza way too much. ...A cheap trick like that'll get exposed in no time.
60.official: You ain't givin' the yakuza near enough credit. He'll see through a trick like that in no time.

62.literal: Ain't you been justifying yourself this whole time?
62.official: Sure, you got yer justifications, but I'll bet you came all this way without ever gettin' yer hands dirty, actin' like a damn choir boy.

63.official: Once a man steps into the shadows like that, he's black as night till the day he dies.

64.literal: In that case... make up your mind and go to hell already!!
64.official: In that case, sack up and meet hell halfway already!

65.literal: ...I'll ask you one more time, for the last time.
65.official: I'll ask just one more time...
